novelty_flags.label: oeq:adaptive-exact-frontier
novelty_flags.one_line: This OEQ is materially the same unresolved exact-phase-intersection question already recorded in banked panel_bhar_proxy_modulus_frontier_proxy_modulus_v1; state a strict new delta or remove it as duplicated internal prior art.

soundness_flags.label: def:honest-interval and thm:honest-length-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The interval is not a determinate statistical object: retained-block scores, its variance formula, stochastic critical value, and the fourth-moment calibration defining q_{1-alpha} are unspecified, so the stated coverage and length theorem has missing terms.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: lem:identification-fwl and Theorems 1–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Event transport equating the event-date untreated cohort mean to the historical conditional surface is maintained, not identified from the observed event panel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All causal identification, risk, and interval claims are conditional on ass:event-transport; placebo windows can diagnose pre-event stability but cannot verify the event-date counterfactual premise.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3; ass:local-two-sided-modulus
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower covariance-standardized local modulus that supplies the donor converse is maintained rather than derived from the Holder ball and other panel primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The donor N^{-min(lambda,1)} channel and resulting frontier are conditional on ass:local-two-sided-modulus; because this load-bearing rate geometry is assumed, the proposal is capped at field tier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section 2.3 and Appendix-A proof text
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies financial event studies based on linear factor models, derives identification and asymptotic-bias conditions, emphasizes volatile and long-horizon settings, and discusses synthetic-control alternatives.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section 3.2, especially discussion following Theorem 3.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies repeated-measurement nonparametric regression, establishes Holder-class convergence rates and matching lower-bound results, and reports a sparse-to-dense phase transition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, contribution bullets; pp. 9–10, two-stage minimum-value procedure
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper estimates a strongly-convex regression minimizer and its minimum value under i.i.d. passive design, using an estimated minimizer followed by nonparametric point evaluation, with minimax rates.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3–4, setup; pp. 15 and 31–32, Theorem 2 and Theorem A
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article constructs conditional synthetic-control prediction intervals, decomposes weight-estimation and post-treatment uncertainty, and extends its distributional approximation to conditionally beta-mixing time series.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1 and 13–14, ordered-modulus definition and Theorem 3.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear regression functionals over convex classes under a fixed Gaussian regression formulation, using ordered moduli.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace def:honest-interval with an exact total formula: define retained-block scores, block-count rule, long-run variance estimator, stochastic critical value, and set q_{1-alpha} explicitly from ass:donor-fourth-moment (or state its tail inequality).
State a strict new delta for the adaptive OEQ relative to the banked sharp-phase-intersections question, or remove the duplicate OEQ and retain it only as inherited future work.
Give event transport an operational domain restriction or sensitivity analysis tied to observed pre-event placebo deviations, rather than relying only on short-window plausibility.

recommended_next_step: Revise the interval into a fully specified total procedure and resolve the duplicated OEQ; then retain the two conditional-scope caveats and advance the joint-law frontier target at field tier.
